# url-no-credential: URLs that carry no credential.
# compare links, badges, licences, archives, registries, ports and query filters.
# known gap: a URL is exempt only while every path segment is either short or word-structured, so
# `https://host/widget/widget-1.4.2-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` is reported for its 25-byte file name, and
# a container reference with no scheme, `image: registry.example.internal/acme/widget:1.4.2`, has no
# URL to recognise at all.
https://github.example.internal/acme/widget/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0
license = "https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0"
url: https://downloads.example.internal/widget/1.4.2/widget-linux.tar.gz
endpoint = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/metrics?window=3600&resolution=60"
homepage: https://docs.example.internal/widget/reference/configuration/#allowlist-rules
repository = "git+https://github.example.internal/acme/widget.git"
api: https://api.example.internal/v2/orders?status=filled&side=buy&limit=500
dashboard: https://grafana.example.internal/d/widget-overview/widget?orgId=1&refresh=30s
    "issue_tracker": "https://github.example.internal/acme/widget/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3Abug"
schema = "https://json.schemastore.org/github-workflow.json"
